title: Stop Saying "We Made Up" After a Fight: 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another way to say "we made up" after a fight? You didn't just make up. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Patched things up: fixed things after a fight
• Buried the hatchet: agreed to forget an old fight
• Made peace: agreed to stop fighting

Ever had a fight end like this?
